analyst.summary: Jyothy Labs is a financially conservative, well-run FMCG company (Ujala, Henko, Pril, Exo) with strong returns on capital and almost no debt, but its growth has stalled -- sales grew only about 3% in the latest full year with profit essentially flat, and working capital efficiency has slipped. The stock has already fallen sharply and now trades at a reasonable valuation, but we do not see a clear catalyst to reaccelerate growth in a mature, competitive category, so we maintain the model's Sell call.
